correctness.rationale: For uniform Lebesgue measure on an affine image of the cube, the orthonormal basis 1, sqrt(3)*y_i yields the exact kernel 1+3<x,y>. Convexity in x and coordinate-reflection symmetry prove a vertex maximizes its absolute integral; a measurable sign function attains it. The Irwin–Hall inclusion–exclusion distribution gives the rational sum for every d>=1. Negative kernel mass is half of norm minus one, and a positive perturbation realizes values below -1 precisely beginning at d=5. Conditional Jensen gives strict monotonicity, while Fourier absolute-value inversion with explicit three-region Gaussian domination gives the two-term asymptotic with coefficient 13/60. Independently convolved polynomial densities exactly matched the alternating sum through d=9; 111 checker assertions passed. Tests are supporting evidence, not universal proof.

originality.rationale: The most relevant exact published prior record calculates affine local projection on simplices by a Dirichlet barycentric kernel; an affine cube is not a simplex and has a continuous independent-uniform sum law with different sqrt(d) versus linear-in-d growth. The published centered Irwin–Hall absolute moment concerns a simplex section-volume derivative, not an L2 projector or a shifted threshold. The primary 2010 manifold-kernel projection paper gives boundedness for kernel spaces, not this exact cellwise norm. The 2022 polynomial-projection monograph studies the discrete Boolean cube with Bernoulli counting measure. Published published-finding corpus searches and full available prior-result statements yielded no implication of the continuous uniform parallelepiped exact norm, dimension-five positivity threshold and second-order coefficient. Residual risk of an older equivalent polynomial projector table is expressly retained.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not independently established. The exact first-degree Legendre tensor-product cube norm may have been computed in older approximation-theory literature or tables not indexed by these searches.
Only relevant sections of long primary works were inspected rather than every page. Foucart full research article was not obtained; its accessible materials concern one-dimensional splines.

The published published-finding corpus searches are negative evidence within their coverage, not mathematical evidence of uniqueness. The proof relies independently on the stated elementary integral identities.

value.rationale: Exact L∞ amplification is a natural robustness invariant for local affine least-squares reconstruction. The all-dimensional rational law has a directly realized extremizing input; the positive-input extrapolation below -1 first appears in exactly dimension five, an interpretable dimensional cutoff. The sharp two-term sqrt(d) asymptotic quantifies a substantive geometrical contrast with simplex d-order instability for the same affine reconstruction degree. The theorem is limited to one cell rather than asserting unproved global finite-element stability.
